sharedAssociations.basis: Repeated Grenada map records cover substantially the same island group in separate snapshot ranges. The shared history distinguishes colonial and independent periods rather than equating their governments.

Repeated Grenada map records cover substantially the same island group in separate snapshot ranges. The shared history distinguishes colonial and independent periods rather than equating their governments.

scopeNotes: Three imported records have matching island-group footprints in different snapshot ranges. They are geographic histories spanning different governments, not a claim of independent statehood in 1715 or 1815. Exact geometry remains unverified.

The modern nation includes Grenada, Carriacou and Petite Martinique. Petite Martinique is distinct from the separate French island Martinique; the northern Grenadines are not all assigned to modern Grenada.

The Museum European Invasion page contains inconsistent 1762/1763 and 1782/1783 treaty dates. The card uses the 1763 treaty text, the Met catalogue and the BnF account of the 1783 peace settlement instead.
The 2008 ceramic paper was read in selected passages. Mineral and chemical assignments are preliminary; older bowl dates and heirloom interpretations do not date the Grand Bay deposit earlier.
Displaced conch shells and early environmental traces are not treated as complete settlement sites. Historical labels and pottery styles do not independently establish ethnicity.

The National Records of Scotland article’s speculative motives, approximate monetary equivalence and erroneous inference of freedom by 1833 are omitted. Archival documents are cited through the institution’s research account.
The US 2004 account is used only for specified modern chronology. Its Indigenous replacement and extinction story, outdated statistics and justification of intervention are not adopted.

UNESCO inscriptions in 2023 and 2024 are recognition dates. They do not mark the invention of boats or the start of Shakespeare Mas’. Public descriptions were read; nomination films were not independently played.
No successor link is invented between the repeated map identifiers. They are associated with one narrative, with political transitions explicitly described.
Independent historical review, depth certification and geometry review remain pending.
